opening.argument: The presentation solicits Bitcoin participation by directing viewers to register a wallet, provide a suggested $100 in Bitcoin, and fund the account within seven days. It attributes the activity to automated software using Bitcoin as the base currency and places the full investment into a trading account, while presenting daily passive income as the expected benefit. It also describes withdrawals into a Bitcoin wallet and optional referral bonuses, extending the opportunity beyond ordinary trading participation. Although the presentation says results are not guaranteed and income depends on positive daily trading results, it still asks viewers to commit Bitcoin in pursuit of claimed daily or passive returns.

citations.quote: To get started you will need a bitcoin wallet to register with Mirotrading international and $100 in bitcoin, which is the suggested minimum. You will need to fund your account within seven days.
Your full investment goes into your trading account. Mirror trading international provides you with a passive income opportunity.
All income is subject to positive daily trading results. The system is fully automated
Mirror Trading International has an optional affiliate program should you wish to refer your friends or new members.
